description: Create a discount code for an event. type is PercentOffDiscountCode (value = percent) or MoneyOffDiscountCode (value = flat amount off per ticket, in the event currency). Undo by editing it (e.g. quantity or end_at) with tito_update_discount_code. Tito: POST /:account/:event/discount_codes.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

code.description: The code attendees enter, e.g. SAVE10.

end_at.description: When the code stops working (ISO 8601 datetime).

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

max_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies to at most this many tickets per release.

min_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies only if at least this many tickets are selected.

only_show_attached.description: When the code is applied, show only the releases attached to it. Default false.

quantity.description: How many tickets can use this code in total.

release_ids.description: Release ids the code applies to (empty = all).

reveal_secret.description: Reveal secret releases when the code is applied. Default false.

start_at.description: When the code starts working (ISO 8601 datetime).

type.description: PercentOffDiscountCode = percentage off; MoneyOffDiscountCode = flat amount off per ticket.

value.description: The amount off per ticket as a decimal string, e.g. "10.0".

name: tito_create_discount_code
title: Create a discount code
